verdict.rationale: ESD's open employer pages are written in plain, second-person language ("If you disagree with our decision... you can appeal", "Filing online reduces errors"). They offer task-oriented how-to pages, such as how to file quarterly tax and wage reports, plus short step-by-step videos for setting up an EAMS account, adding an employer and filing a no-payroll report. This goes beyond statute text and form numbers. Missing for 10: written step-by-step walkthroughs (the steps are mostly in videos, and some tasks just point to a PDF form), evidence of guidance for core founder tasks such as first-time employer registration, and independent or hands-on corroboration that a non-lawyer can follow it.
